title: Patch: a failed chat read offers Try again and never passes for an empty conversation

# #1898: Patch: a failed chat read offers Try again and never passes for an empty conversation
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

In a friend chat, one failed load today leaves the error line on screen forever — even after later messages arrive fine — and a failed first load is labelled 'No messages yet. Say hello!' as if the friend simply had not written. After this, a failed read explains itself with a Try again button like the friends list beside it already does, a retry or later successful poll clears the error, and a failed load never poses as an empty chat.

## Why

`ChatPanel.tsx`'s read effect sets `error` on failure but the success arm never clears it — only `send`/`report` do — so a transient failed poll leaves a stuck `role="alert"` under a healthy conversation. Line 192 renders the empty-conversation copy on `loaded && messages.length === 0`, which a failed first read satisfies. The alert has no retry, while `InMatchChat.tsx:37-50` offers `TryAgainButton` for the same failure.

## Proposal

Clear `error` in the read's success path, gate the empty copy on `error === null`, and add a retry affordance (`chat-retry` testid mirroring `inMatchRetry`).

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/together/ChatPanel.tsx:74-96, 132, 149, 192, 266-270`; precedent `apps/web/src/together/InMatchChat.tsx:37-50`; test in `ChatPanel.test.tsx` (`serve()` already returns refusals, fake timers drive `CHAT_POLL_MS`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Failed first read shows the alert and not the 'No messages yet' copy.
- [ ] A later successful poll — or clicking Try again — clears the alert.
- [ ] Existing ChatPanel tests pass.

## Size and risks

Small, likely difficulty easy: one component plus its test. Follows the accepted 'failed read offers Try again' pattern (#1783).
